rationale: Manual human promotion decision (no automated run_benchmark/decide_promotion was used -- that mechanism scores a single legacy overall_label.grade against a baseline evaluator, not this architecture's single CORAL-head overall score derived from the four-canonical-dimension equal-weight-mean training target; see overall_dataset.py module docstring). deberta_v3_base_overall_single_v3_epoch6 (best epoch 6 of 8, selected by best validation mean QWK) was trained on the frozen four_dim_experiment_v2 166/27/27 split, one shared microsoft/deberta-v3-base backbone + one CoralOrdinalHead, unweighted CORAL loss (no A1/A2 loss weighting). Reported metrics: validation QWK 0.7111, test QWK 0.6667, test accuracy 0.5185, test within-1 accuracy 0.9259, test MAE 0.5556. Approved for production deployment as an explicit, isolated alternative to A2 -- see deployed_model_overall_single_v3/README.md for the full architecture and rollback discussion.
